_status: READY - dataset v2 frozen. Awaiting the owner's explicit "start" before the pilot volume or any GPU is created.

model.trainer: DiffSynth-Studio @4a2d8af77849b20702b2639338f6fe4512f2f93e (same commit as the passed smoke test)

dataset.pairs: 28 = 24 strong + confirmed R1-17, P3, P12, P41; P9 and P1 kept for comparison only; O-023, O-012 excluded
dataset.composition: make_pilot.py on v2: 100 rows x 3 epochs = 300 steps; 80 still rows (35 usual lean, 14 level, 29 opposite lean, 2 full body), 20 clip rows
dataset.validation_use: scoring only, after training; never trained on or used to pick a checkpoint

optim.precision: bf16 weights, no fp8 (A40/A6000 48 GB, as in the smoke test)

loss.name: face_loss.FlowMatchIdentityLoss
loss.prompt: one constant motion prompt for every sample (no per-sample hints)

identity_safeguards: drivers are other women (identity vs Sienna <= 0.35) so identity can only come from the reference
head-only loss: body, outfit, background never supervised
no mirrored images (would flip her facial asymmetry); tilt balanced by in-plane rotation only, reflected borders excluded from the loss
validation images never trained on, never a reference
small LoRA, 300 steps, checkpoints at 100/200/300 to catch overfitting

anti_selfie_tilt.before: 24/24 targets lean the same way (-8..-27 deg)
anti_selfie_tilt.after: 80 still rows: 33 usual lean, 23 level, 24 opposite lean (+6..+18 deg)

priority_weighting: head turns |yaw|>=12, open smiles/laughs, full body: one extra original + one level-tilt copy each, and their pseudo-clips first
stop_conditions: loss NaN or > 3x its first-20-step mean for 20 steps
mean step time implies > 150 min of training
LoRA key check fails or LoRA has no visible effect in WA2

storage.pilot_volume: sienna-wa2-pilot, 20 GB, mounted at /pilotvol, created only at launch, deleted after verified backups (pilot_guard.py)
storage.production_volume: sienna-studio (u4odco714x) refused by id and name

spending.enforced_by: pilot_guard.py ledger + per-pod self-delete deadline from remaining budget
